section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the aims of the present study, listing three primary goals: (1) gender differences and relations between exercise and body-as-process orientation and body appreciation; (2) effects of weight loss talk (negative) and exercise talk (positive) on body appreciation; and (3) mediation hypotheses where body-as-object/process views mediate relationships between talk types and body appreciation. The section refers to a single 'present study' and provides hypotheses but no methodological or sample details.
section_summary.evidence_source: In the present study, we had three goals. First, we expected that women would endorse higher scores on the body-as-object orientation versus body-as-process... Second, we expected that weight loss talk would negatively predict and exercise talk would positively predict body appreciation. Third, we hypothesized that viewing the body-as-object would mediate the relationship between weight loss talk and body appreciation, and viewing the body-as-process would mediate the relationship between exercise talk and body appreciation.
